SELECT cm.complete_name AS maker, ml.mode AS model
FROM car_makers AS cm
JOIN model_list AS ml ON ml.produced_by = cm.Id;
--

SELECT a."Airline"
FROM "airlines" AS a
JOIN "flights" AS f ON f."Airline" = a."uid"
WHERE f."SourceAirport" IN ('APG', 'CVO')
GROUP BY a."uid", a."Airline"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f."SourceAirport") = 2;

SELECT a.*
FROM airlines AS a
JOIN flights AS f ON f.aircraft_company = a.uid
WHERE f.flight_from IN ('APG', 'CVO')
GROUP BY a.uid
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_from) = 2;

SELECT p.first_name, p.country_code
FROM players AS p
JOIN rankings AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY r.tours DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.given_name, p.nation_code
FROM players AS p
JOIN rankings AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY r.tours DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Continent
FROM country AS c
JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON cl.CountryCode = c.Code
GROUP BY c.Continent
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cl.Language) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.mainland FROM country AS c JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON cl.CountryCode = c.Code GROUP BY c.mainland ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cl.dialect) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language <> 'English';
SELECT DISTINCT "CountryCode" FROM "countrylanguage" WHERE "dialect" <> 'English';

SELECT c.Code
FROM country AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM countrylanguage AS cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code
      AND cl.Language = 'English'
);

SELECT c.Code
FROM country AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM countrylanguage AS cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code
      AND cl.dialect = 'English'
);

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM Professionals AS p
JOIN Treatments AS t ON t.professional_id = p.professional_id
WHERE t.cost_of_treatment < (SELECT AVG(cost_of_treatment) FROM Treatments);

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, p.surname
FROM Professionals AS p
JOIN Treatments AS t ON t.professional_id = p.professional_id
WHERE t.cost_of_treatment < (SELECT AVG(cost_of_treatment) FROM Treatments);

SELECT first_name
FROM (
    SELECT first_name FROM Professionals
    UNION
    SELECT first_name FROM Owners
) AS people
WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Dogs
      WHERE Dogs.name = people.first_name
  );

SELECT first_name
FROM (
    SELECT forename AS first_name FROM Professionals
    UNION
    SELECT forename AS first_name FROM Owners
) AS names
WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Dogs
      WHERE Dogs.name = names.first_name
  );

SELECT DISTINCT "Year"
FROM "cars_data"
WHERE "Weight" BETWEEN 3000 AND 4000
ORDER BY "Year";

SELECT DISTINCT "Year"
FROM "cars_data"
WHERE "wt" BETWEEN 3000 AND 4000
ORDER BY "Year";

SELECT f."FlightNo"
FROM "flights" AS f
JOIN "airlines" AS a ON f."Airline" = a."uid"
WHERE a."Airline" = 'United Airlines';
--

SELECT f."FlightNo"
FROM "flights" AS f
JOIN "airlines" AS a ON f."air" = a."uid"
WHERE a."air" = 'United Airlines';

SELECT DISTINCT a."Airline"
FROM "airlines" AS a
JOIN "flights" AS f ON f."Airline" = a."uid"
WHERE f."DestAirport" = 'AHD';
--

SELECT DISTINCT a.air
FROM airlines AS a
JOIN flights AS f ON f.air = a.uid
WHERE f.destapt = 'AHD';

SELECT country_code
FROM players
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT cntry_code
FROM players
GROUP BY cntry_code
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT "Package_Option", "ser_name" FROM "TV_Channel" WHERE "hd" = 'Yes';

SELECT AVG(pp.Earnings) AS average_earnings
FROM poker_player AS pp
JOIN people AS p ON pp.People_ID = p.People_ID
WHERE p.Height > 200;

SELECT AVG(pp."Earnings") AS average_earnings
FROM "poker_player" AS pp
JOIN "people" AS p ON pp."ppl_id" = p."ppl_id"
WHERE p."ht" > 200;
SELECT vote_id, phone_number, state FROM VOTES;
SELECT vote_id, ph, st FROM VOTES;

SELECT AVG("Attendance") FROM "show";

SELECT AVG(attend) FROM "show";
SELECT MAX(charge_amount) AS charge_amount FROM Charges;
SELECT MAX(chrg_amt) AS chrg_amt FROM Charges;

SELECT DISTINCT r.feature_type_name
FROM Other_Available_Features AS f
JOIN Ref_Feature_Types AS r ON r.feature_type_code = f.feature_type_code
WHERE f.feature_name = 'AirCon';

SELECT DISTINCT rft.feature_type_name
FROM Ref_Feature_Types AS rft
JOIN Other_Available_Features AS oaf
  ON oaf.feat_type_code = rft.feature_type_code
WHERE oaf.feature_name = 'AirCon';

SELECT s.Name, COUNT(sc.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM singer AS s
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sc ON sc.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Singer_ID, s.Name;

SELECT s.Name, COUNT(sc.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM singer AS s
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sc ON s.Singer_ID = sc.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Singer_ID, s.Name;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars_data WHERE CAST(Horsepower AS REAL) > 150;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars_data WHERE CAST(Horsepower AS INTEGER) > 150;
SELECT "Location", COUNT(*) AS shop_count FROM "shop" GROUP BY "Location";

SELECT Document_ID
FROM Paragraphs
GROUP BY Document_ID
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 2;

SELECT Document_ID
FROM Paragraphs
GROUP BY Document_ID
HAVING COUNT(*) IN (1, 2);

SELECT country_code
FROM players
GROUP BY country_code
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50;

SELECT country_code
FROM players
GROUP BY country_code
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50;

SELECT Name
FROM country
WHERE Continent = 'Asia'
  AND Population > (SELECT MAX(Population) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Africa');

SELECT Name
FROM country
WHERE Continent = 'Asia'
  AND Population > (SELECT MAX(Population) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Africa');

SELECT Name
FROM country
ORDER BY Population DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT Name FROM country ORDER BY Population DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.Name
FROM city AS c
JOIN countrylanguage AS cl ON cl.CountryCode = c.CountryCode
WHERE cl.Language = 'English'
ORDER BY c.Population DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT city.Name
FROM city
JOIN countrylanguage ON countrylanguage.CountryCode = city.CountryCode
WHERE countrylanguage.Language = 'English'
ORDER BY city.Population * countrylanguage.Percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Year_of_Work DESC;
SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Year_of_Work ASC;

SELECT h.name
FROM Highschooler AS h
WHERE h.grade > 5
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Friend AS f WHERE f.student_id = h.ID) >= 2;

SELECT h.name
FROM Highschooler AS h
JOIN Friend AS f ON f.student_id = h.ID
WHERE h.grade > 5
GROUP BY h.ID, h.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

SELECT DISTINCT cm.Maker
FROM car_makers AS cm
JOIN model_list AS ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
JOIN car_names AS cn ON cn.Model = ml.Model
JOIN cars_data AS cd ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
WHERE cd.Year = 1970;

SELECT DISTINCT cm.FullName
FROM car_makers AS cm
JOIN model_list AS ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
JOIN car_names AS cn ON cn.Model = ml.Model
JOIN cars_data AS cd ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
WHERE cd.Year = 1970;

SELECT DISTINCT cm."Maker"
FROM "car_makers" AS cm
JOIN "model_list" AS ml ON ml."Maker" = cm."Id"
JOIN "car_names" AS cn ON cn."Model" = ml."Model"
JOIN "cars_data" AS cd ON cd."Id" = cn."MakeId"
WHERE cd."Year" = 1970;

SELECT DISTINCT cm."Maker"
FROM "cars_data" AS cd
JOIN "car_names" AS cn ON cn."MakeId" = cd."Id"
JOIN "model_list" AS ml ON ml."Model" = cn."Model"
JOIN "car_makers" AS cm ON cm."Id" = ml."Maker"
WHERE cd."Year" = 1970;

SELECT cn.Model
FROM cars_data AS cd
JOIN car_names AS cn ON cn.MakeId = cd.Id
WHERE cd.Cylinders = 4
ORDER BY CAST(cd.Horsepower AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT cn.Model, CAST(cd.Horsepower AS INTEGER) AS Horsepower
FROM car_names AS cn
JOIN cars_data AS cd ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
WHERE cd.Cylinders = 4 AND cd.Horsepower IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(cd.Horsepower AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(Number_products) AS min_products, MAX(Number_products) AS max_products FROM shop;
SELECT MIN(Number_products) AS min_goods, MAX(Number_products) AS max_goods FROM shop;

SELECT s.semester_name
FROM Semesters AS s
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS e ON e.semester_id = s.semester_id
JOIN Degree_Programs AS d ON d.degree_program_id = e.degree_program_id
GROUP BY s.semester_id, s.semester_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.degree_summary_name LIKE '%Master%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.degree_summary_name LIKE '%Bachelor%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;

SELECT DISTINCT dp.degree_summary_name, s.date_first_registered, s.date_left
FROM Student_Enrolment AS se
JOIN Degree_Programs AS dp ON dp.degree_program_id = se.degree_program_id
JOIN Students AS s ON s.student_id = se.student_id
WHERE dp.degree_summary_name LIKE '%Master%'
   OR dp.degree_summary_name LIKE '%Bachelor%';

SELECT MAX("Share"), MIN("Share") FROM "performance" WHERE "Type" <> 'Live final';
--

SELECT MAX(CAST(Share AS REAL)) AS largest_percentage,
       MIN(CAST(Share AS REAL)) AS smallest_percentage
FROM performance
WHERE Type <> 'Live final';

SELECT Record_Company
FROM orchestra
GROUP BY Record_Company
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Record_Company
FROM orchestra
GROUP BY Record_Company
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT Orchestra_ID) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.name
FROM Dogs AS d
WHERE COALESCE((
    SELECT SUM(t.cost_of_treatment)
    FROM Dogs AS owned_dog
    JOIN Treatments AS t ON t.dog_id = owned_dog.dog_id
    WHERE owned_dog.owner_id = d.owner_id
), 0) <= 1000;
--

SELECT d.*
FROM Dogs AS d
WHERE COALESCE((
    SELECT SUM(t.cost_of_treatment)
    FROM Treatments AS t
    WHERE t.dog_id = d.dog_id
), 0) <= 1000;

SELECT "Year"
FROM "concert"
GROUP BY "Year"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Year
FROM concert
GROUP BY Year
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC, Year ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Horsepower
FROM cars_data
ORDER BY Accelerate DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Horsepower FROM cars_data ORDER BY Accelerate ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name, Location, District FROM shop ORDER BY Number_products DESC;

SELECT winner_name
FROM matches
WHERE tourney_name = 'Australian Open'
  AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY winner_rank_points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT winner_name
FROM matches
WHERE tourney_name = 'Australian Open'
  AND winner_rank_points IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY winner_rank_points ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.student_id AS id, s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name,
       COUNT(*) AS number_of_enrollments, se.student_id
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se ON se.student_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name, se.student_id
ORDER BY number_of_enrollments DESC, s.student_id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.student_id AS id,
       s.first_name,
       s.middle_name,
       s.last_name,
       COUNT(*) AS number_of_enrollments,
       s.student_id
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se ON se.student_id = s.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id
ORDER BY number_of_enrollments, s.student_id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Production_code, Channel
FROM Cartoon
ORDER BY date(Original_air_date) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Production_code, Channel
FROM Cartoon
ORDER BY Original_air_date ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Earnings FROM poker_player ORDER BY Earnings DESC;
SELECT Earnings FROM poker_player ORDER BY Earnings ASC;

SELECT Name
FROM country
ORDER BY Population DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT "Name" FROM "country" ORDER BY "Population" ASC, "Name" ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT grade
FROM Highschooler
GROUP BY grade
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, grade
LIMIT 1;

SELECT grade
FROM Highschooler
GROUP BY grade
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT o.owner_id, o.last_name
FROM Owners AS o
JOIN Dogs AS d ON d.owner_id = o.owner_id
JOIN Treatments AS t ON t.dog_id = d.dog_id
GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.last_name
ORDER BY COUNT(t.treatment_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH treatment_counts AS (
  SELECT o.owner_id, o.last_name, COUNT(t.treatment_id) AS treatment_count
  FROM Owners AS o
  LEFT JOIN Dogs AS d ON d.owner_id = o.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN Treatments AS t ON t.dog_id = d.dog_id
  GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.last_name
)
SELECT owner_id, last_name
FROM treatment_counts
WHERE treatment_count = (SELECT MIN(treatment_count) FROM treatment_counts);
